prompt: You are a fresh experiment integrity auditor. Assume the evaluation may be compromised and verify the primary artifacts directly. Do not trust or infer any executor narrative. Read every listed file line by line. Audit A ground-truth/reference provenance, B score normalization, C result existence and recomputation, D dead-code/phantom results, E scope, and F evaluation type. Also inspect future-information leakage, actual-vs-sham physical transition equality, old WHOLE action preservation, exact replay closure, and whether any issue could turn WEAKEN into a different conclusion. Classify at most three P0/P1 issues; for each explain exactly how it changes the result. If there is no clear P0/P1, state that the experiment may proceed. Return A-F with file:line evidence, overall verdict, integrity status, evaluation type, claim impact for C1/C2/bounded WEAKEN, and same-family provisional metadata.
